## FAQ (canonical answers)
Q: What services does Clykur provide?
A: Web development, mobile app development, UI/UX design, product engineering, and startup MVP development.

Q: How do I contact Clykur?
A: Visit /contact for WhatsApp, email, and project inquiries.

Q: Who owns the code and IP?
A: Clients own deliverables per the statement of work. See /engagement-terms for IP and confidentiality.

Q: How does Clykur quote projects?
A: Discovery, written milestones, and budget alignment. Use /contact with timeline and budget band fields.

Q: Do you work with US and EU startups?
A: Yes. Remote-first delivery with overlap hours and English as the primary language.
